method: Soft voting: average of the members' softmax probabilities (equal weights)
explanation: Val accuracy 0.979 (+0.4 pts vs E8 alone, ~7 more correct images out of 1976 - within noise, ~1.2 standard errors). Adding weaker models (ResNet18, simple CNN) to the vote LOWERED accuracy (0.973-0.974): averaging only helps when members are comparably strong.
preprocessing_why: Members see the image at different resolutions, so their errors are partly independent.
